content: [Feishu #growth-team bob Mon Nov 13 14:00 PST 2023] Quick update on exp003 — I checked the SRM status last week and it looked fine. Control and treatment groups were well-balanced. The bot traffic issue in the control group shouldn't affect the SRM check since bots are still counted as users.

Bob's claim noted, but this requires verification. The SRM check measures traffic allocation balance (actual vs. expected ratio), not data quality. Bot traffic contamination is a separate issue that affects the validity of metric measurements, not the traffic split itself. Need to verify exp003 SRM independently.

[Feishu #growth-team bob Mon Nov 13 14:12 PST 2023] Also, all our analysis outputs should follow a standard format. I've been requiring that all judgment-type outputs include a `reason` field explaining the basis for the conclusion. This helps with audit trails and makes it easier to review decisions.
Noted: judgment-type outputs should include a `reason` field (P4). This applies to eligibility checks, diagnostic conclusions, and similar judgment outputs.

[Feishu #growth-team alice Mon Nov 13 15:00 PST 2023] Agree with Bob on the reason field requirement. Also, exp003 needs to be re-analyzed after the bot traffic cleanup. The original FINAL report conclusions should be treated as preliminary until we see the cleaned data.
Understood: exp003 FINAL report conclusions are preliminary pending bot traffic cleanup re-analysis. Will not use original conclusions as ground truth.
